title: Topic 7
japanese_text: 「フィガロの結婚」はモーツァルトが<u>手掛けた</u>有名な<u>オペラ</u>で、<u>貴族</u>に<u>仕える</u>フィガロの結婚にまつわる事件を描いた<u>喜劇</u>だ。<u>弾む</u>ようなリズムの明るい曲が多く、初心者でも楽しく見られるだろう。
english_translation: The Marriage of Figaro is a famous opera worked on by Mozart, and it is a comedy that depicts incidents surrounding the marriage of Figaro who serves the nobility. It has many bright songs with bouncing rhythms, so even beginners can enjoy it.
